title: FAMILY, SCHOOL, AND COMMUNITY COLLABORATION
description: Focus on family, school, community environments and interactions for children from infancy to adolescence. Resources and skills for enhancing child development across these settings are emphasized.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: HDFS 311 or 313.
A minimum grade of C- is required in HDFS 311 and HDFS 313.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:20am in KEAR 112 - Kearney Hall 112 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
